title: feat: add GPT Realtime 2.1 Mini
author: ElliotEtag
pr_body_excerpt:
- Adds `gpt-realtime-2.1-mini` through Azure East US 2 Global Standard at 300 RPM / 150,000 TPM.
- Bills text, audio, image, output, and cached modality tokens at exact published rates.
- Keeps session billing state bounded to aggregate usage plus two cache counters; missing/incomplete cache detail emits a warning.
- Adds routing, discovery, pricing, wallet, and Tinybird coverage. No secrets changed.

| Contract | Value |
|---|---|
| Canonical / aliases | `gpt-realtime-2.1-mini` / none |
| Multiplier / paid-only | `0.75` / no |
| Pollinations GPU | no |
| Registry provider | Azure |
| Primary route | `myceli-prod-eastus2` → `gpt-realtime-2-1-mini` |
| Fallback | none |

Validation: direct Azure E2E passed text, image, speech, all 10 voices, tools, reasoning, cancellation, audio formats, caching, 30 concurrent sessions, and a 100,025-input-token request. The exact model page specifies 128K context / 32K output; the 32K review claim referenced deprecated `gpt-realtime-mini`. Local Worker→Azure passed text, PCM audio, usage, and deduction. Gen passes 679/679, focused Enter passes 291/291, typecheck/build pass.

gist.headline: Tiny realtime, big ears
gist.blurb: A new little listener joined the hive: GPT Realtime 2.1 Mini now handles text, images, speech, tools, and all ten voices. Polli has prepared the audio garden accordingly.
gist.summary: Added Azure-hosted `gpt-realtime-2.1-mini` to the realtime API via the East US 2 Global Standard route, with 300 RPM, 150,000 TPM, 128K context, 32K output, and exact per-modality billing for text, audio, images, output, and cached tokens.
gist.impact: Builders can use `gpt-realtime-2.1-mini` for large-context realtime text, image, and voice sessions—including PCM audio, tools, reasoning, cancellation, caching, and ten voices—while wallet deductions reflect the model's published modality rates.
gist.visual_concept: Depict the new compact realtime model as a cozy little retro audio terminal with waveform vines, a microphone, a tiny camera tile, and speech bubbles flowing through it to represent multimodal realtime sessions. Polli, wearing small studio headphones, tends the signal garden while a CRT monitor robot happily watches the waveforms; lime-green cables and code-plants represent routing, usage tracking, and wallet-aware billing.
